mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 61 degrees with moderate drizzle near City Hall, and we are currently seeing a first quarter moon.

Road maintenance is coming to Verona starting September 23, with chip sealing work scheduled for Cross Country Road, East Verona Avenue, and the Liberty Business Park. Additionally, the Plan Commission will meet on October 5 to discuss various development projects around the area.

There is plenty to do this weekend, starting with the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival today and the Dane County Farmers Market today as well. Tomorrow, look out for the Bike the Barns fundraiser at Badger Prairie County Park.
In our weekly police report, on September 10, officers responded to a burglary on Hunters Cove Way where they apprehended a 19-year-old suspect after a shot was fired.
The Culver's of Verona location is currently closed for a remodel, but you can head over when they open today at 10:00 AM.
